snippet.title: Stario: Haven Tower Early Access Trailer - 2025 Convergence Game Showcase
snippet.description:
Stario: Haven Tower reimagines the city-building genre by focusing all the complexity and wonder of urban management into a single, ever-rising tower. Players must expand upward through shifting skies and hostile conditions, balancing survival, growth, and the hopes of their Towertizens. This trailer announces the Early Access release date, and debuted in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209750
